item.title: Rooftop Jazz in Two Formats

turns.text: I need the same 10-second Rooftop Jazz promo in 9:16 for Stories and 16:9 for a venue screen. Sunset rooftop, musicians playing, mellow jazz, no voiceover. Show 'Rooftop Jazz', '18 July 2026' and 'Sky Terrace, Manchester'. Make both versions fill the frame and keep all the text readable.

item.tests: Checks delivery of two correctly composed aspect-ratio variants with matching event content, readable overlays and no letterboxing.

answer_sheet.Deliverables and sizes: Two separate 10-second videos: one 9:16 for Stories and one 16:9 for a venue screen.
answer_sheet.Exact event text: Rooftop Jazz; 18 July 2026; Sky Terrace, Manchester
answer_sheet.Visual style: Musicians playing on a rooftop at sunset, with matching styling across both versions.
answer_sheet.Audio: Mellow jazz in both versions, no voiceover.

must_haves: Two separate playable videos are delivered, each 10 seconds long: one 9:16 and one 16:9.
Both versions show rooftop musicians at sunset with consistent styling and event content.
Both versions display exactly 'Rooftop Jazz', '18 July 2026' and 'Sky Terrace, Manchester'.
All three text lines are fully inside each frame and readable together for at least 3 seconds.
Both compositions fill their frames without black bars, stretched imagery or cropped-off musicians' faces.
Both videos contain mellow jazz and no voiceover.

params.prompt_or_change: Cinematic photography of a small jazz ensemble playing on a rooftop at sunset, warm amber light, mellow intimate atmosphere, Manchester skyline, musicians grouped in the central third so a vertical crop retains the performance, no text.

steps.why: Create the opening rooftop shot with composition suitable for both formats.

params.prompt_or_change: Slow gentle push-in toward the rooftop jazz ensemble, subtle natural playing movements and drifting sunset clouds; keep the musicians centrally framed.

Cinematic photography: reframe this same rooftop performance into a closer view of the saxophonist, with the other musicians softly visible behind; preserve performers, clothing, instruments, rooftop and warm sunset lighting, keeping the main subject in the central third for a vertical crop; no text.

steps.why: Create a complementary detail shot while retaining the same setting and performers.

params.prompt_or_change: Gentle cinematic push-in on the saxophonist, subtle swaying and restrained performance motion in warm sunset light; keep the subject centered.

params.extra: Instrumental only; no vocals or speech; trim to 10 seconds if necessary.
params.prompt_or_change: Mellow rooftop jazz with warm saxophone, soft brushed drums, upright bass and gentle piano, relaxed sunset mood, short resolved ending, no vocals.

steps.why: Supply the requested mellow jazz without speech.

params.extra: Play shots in input order, 5 seconds each; use only the supplied music as audio.
params.prompt_or_change: Join the two sunset rooftop shots with mellow jazz for a full-frame 10-second promo, without voiceover.
